entities.summary: David Vadim is a Ukrainian-American actor who appeared in the movies Air Force One, Exit Wounds, G.I. Jane and Punisher: War Zone. He is a former boxing champion and has performed on stage off-Broadway, and on various tours throughout the country. He has recently worked on the TV shows Allegiance and Daredevil.
